term.description: keyword or phrase to search for. It becomes title of active search

filter_id.description: long format ID of filter_type (mandatory if filter_type != "public")

article_ids.description: Array of articles ids. Accepts empty arrays.

search_filters.description: expects one of values from ["all", "titles", "contents"]. Default = "all"

search_match.description: expects one of values from ["all_words", "any_word", "full_phrase", "advanced"]. Default = "all_words"

search_feed_popularity.description: expects one of values from ["all_sites", "popular_sites", "most_popular_sites"]. Default = "all_sites". Property is in effect only if filter_type = "public"
